## Naming Convention

Each file renamed to: `[model_type]_[description]_[precision]_[version].safetensors`

Where:
- **model_type**: vae, clip, t5, qwen, gemma, mistral, sdcheckpoint, diffusion, controlnet, clipvision, embedding, lora, ipadapter, style
- **description**: Lowercase, hyphenated, key model identifiers removed/normalized
- **precision**: fp16, bf16, fp8 (detected from original filename, normalized to lowercase)
- **version**: Extracted from original version markers (v1, v2, 2.1, 6-2, etc.)

### Precision Detection & Normalization

| Original | Normalized |
|----------|------------|
| fp16, FP16 | fp16 |
| bf16, BF16 | bf16 |
| fp8, FP8 | fp8 |
| fp32, FP32 | fp16 (default for SD) |
| No marker | fp16 (default) |

### Version Extraction Rules

- `v1`, `v1-0`, `v1_0` → `v1`
- `v2`, `v2-0`, `v2_0` → `v2`
- `2.1`, `2.1_0` → `21`
- `6-2`, `6_2` → `62`
- `v5-0`, `v5_0` → `v50`
- `fp8_scaled` → no version number (precision only)

<#

$ModelRoot = "K:\.ai_local\SwarmUI\Models"
$MetadataExt = ".metadata.json"

# Category mapping: parent directory -> model type and naming function
$CategoryMap = @{
    "vae" = @{
        "type" = "vae"
        "rename" = { param($fname) 
            # Extract precision
            $prec = if ($fname -match '(fp16|bf16|fp8)') { $matches[1].ToLower() } else { "fp16" }
            # Extract version
            $ver = if ($fname -match 'v(\d+[-_.]\d+)') { 
                $v = $matches[1] -replace '[_-]', '-' 
                $v 
            } elseif ($fname -match '(\d+\.\d+)') { 
                $v = $matches[1] -replace '\.', '-' 
                $v 
            } else { "unknown" }
            # Clean description
            $desc = $fname -replace '\.safetensors$', ''
            $desc = $desc -replace '(Vision|VAE|vae|Model|model)', ''
            $desc = $desc -replace '_', '-'
            $desc = $desc -replace '^-|-$', ''
            "$type" + "_" + $desc.ToLower() + "_" + $prec + "_$ver"
        }
    }
    "text_encoders" = @{
        "type" = "clip"
        "subdir" = @{
            "clip" = "clip"
            "umt5" = "clip"  
            "t5xxl" = "clip"
            "qwen" = "clip"
            "gemma" = "clip"
            "mistral" = "clip"
        }
        "rename" = { param($fname)
            $prec = if ($fname -match '(fp16|bf16|fp8)') { $matches[1].ToLower() } else { "fp16" }
            $namePart = $fname -replace '\.safetensors$', ''
            # Remove known prefixes
            $clean = $namePart -replace '(umt5_|t5xxl_|qwen_|gemma_|mistral_)', ''
            $clean = $clean -replace '_', '-'
            "$type" + "_" + $clean.ToLower() + "_" + $prec
        }
    }
    "stable-diffusion" = @{
        "type" = "sdcheckpoint"
        "rename" = { param($fname)
            $prec = if ($fname -match '(fp16|bf16|fp8)') { $matches[1].ToLower() } else { "fp16" }
            $namePart = $fname -replace '\.safetensors$', ''
            # Remove common prefixes and normalize
            $clean = $namePart -replace '(Realistic|Vision|DreamShaper|CyberRealistic|Babes|Illustrious)', ''
            $clean = $clean -replace '_', '-'
            $clean = $clean -replace '^-|-$', ''
            "$type" + "-" + $clean.ToLower() + "_" + $prec
        }
    }
    "diffusion_models" = @{
        "type" = "diffusion"
        "rename" = { param($fname)
            $prec = if ($fname -match '(fp16|bf16|fp8)') { $matches[1].ToLower() } else { "fp16" }
            $namePart = $fname -replace '\.safetensors$', ''
            $clean = $namePart -replace '(WAN|wan|I2V|T2V|NSFW|Lightning|Lightx2|LowNoise)', ''
            $clean = $clean -replace '_', '-'
            "$type" + "-" + $clean.ToLower() + "_" + $prec
        }
    }
    "controlnet" = @{
        "type" = "controlnet"
        "rename" = { param($fname)
            $prec = if ($fname -match '(fp16|bf16|fp8)') { $matches[1].ToLower() } else { "fp16" }
            $namePart = $fname -replace '\.safetensors$', ''
            $clean = $namePart -replace '(controlnet|ControlNet)', ''
            $clean = $clean -replace '_', '-'
            "$type" + "_" + $clean.ToLower() + "_" + $prec
        }
    }
    "clip_vision" = @{
        "type" = "clipvision"
        "rename" = { param($fname)
            $prec = if ($fname -match '(fp16|bf16|fp8)') { $matches[1].ToLower() } else { "fp16" }
            $namePart = $fname -replace '\.safetensors$', ''
            $clean = $namePart -replace '(clip_vision|CLIP|sigclip)', ''
            $clean = $clean -replace '_', '-'
            "$type" + "_" + $clean.ToLower() + "_" + $prec
        }
    }
    "embeddings" = @{
        "type" = "embedding"
        "subdir" = @{
            "Positive" = "positives"
            "positive" = "positives"
            "Negatives" = "negatives"
            "negative" = "negatives"  
            "Lazy" = "lazy"
            "lazy" = "lazy"
        }
        "rename" = { param($fname)
            $prec = if ($fname -match '(fp16|bf16|fp8)') { $matches[1].ToLower() } else { "fp16" }
            $namePart = $fname -replace '\.safetensors$', ''
            # Determine if positive or negative
            $typeSub = "positives"
            if ($namePart -match '[Nn]egative') { $typeSub = "negatives" }
            if ($namePart -match '[Ll]azy') { $typeSub = "lazy" }
            $clean = $namePart -replace '(Positive|Negative|Lazy)?', ''
            $clean = $clean -replace '_', '-'
            "$type" + "_" + $typeSub + "-" + $clean.ToLower() + "_" + $prec
        }
    }
    "lora" = @{
        "type" = "lora"
        "rename" = { param($fname)
            $prec = if ($fname -match '(fp16|bf16|fp8)') { $matches[1].ToLower() } else { "fp16" }
            $namePart = $fname -replace '\.safetensors$', ''
            # Remove markers like 🫀, 💗, etc. and normalize
            $clean = $namePart -replace '[🫀💗🔥✨]', ''
            $clean = $clean -replace '_', '-'
            $clean = $clean -replace '^-|-$', ''
            "$type" + "_" + $clean.ToLower() + "_" + $prec
        }
    }
    "ipadapter" = @{
        "type" = "ipadapter"
        "rename" = { param($fname)
            $prec = if ($fname -match '(fp16|bf16|fp8)') { $matches[1].ToLower() } else { "fp16" }
            $namePart = $fname -replace '\.safetensors$', ''
            $clean = $namePart -replace '(ip-adapter|IP-Adapter|ipadapter)', ''
            $clean = $clean -replace '_', '-'
            "$type" + "_" + $clean.ToLower() + "_" + $prec
        }
    }
    "style_models" = @{
        "type" = "style"
        "rename" = { param($fname)
            $prec = if ($fname -match '(fp16|bf16|fp8)') { $matches[1].ToLower() } else { "fp16" }
            $namePart = $fname -replace '\.safetensors$', ''
            $clean = $namePart -replace '(style|Style|MODEL|model)', ''
            $clean = $clean -replace '_', '-'
            "$type" + "_" + $clean.ToLower() + "_" + $prec
        }
    }
    default = @{
        "type" = "other"
        "rename" = { param($fname) {
            $prec = if ($fname -match '(fp16|bf16|fp8)') { $matches[1].ToLower() } else { "fp16" }
            $namePart = $fname -replace '\.safetensors$', ''
            $clean = $namePart -replace '_', '-'
            "$type" + "_" + $clean.ToLower() + "_" + $prec
        }
    }
}

# Get all .safetensors files
$files = Get-ChildItem -Path $ModelRoot -Filter "*.safetensors" -Recurse | Where-Object { -not $_.PsIsContainer }

Write-Host "Found $($files.Count) .safetensors files" -ForegroundColor Cyan

# Create target directories
$targetDirs = @("vae", "text_encoders/clip", "text_encoders/qwen", "text_encoders/gemma", "text_encoders/mistral",
                "stable-diffusion", "diffusion_models", "controlnet", "clip_vision", "embeddings/positives", 
                "embeddings/negatives", "embeddings/lazy", "lora", "ipadapter", "style_models")

foreach ($dir in $targetDirs) {
    $fullPath = Join-Path $ModelRoot $dir
    if (-not (Test-Path $fullPath)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $fullPath -Force | Out-Null
    }
}

# Ensure embedding subdirectories exist
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $ModelRoot "embeddings/positives") -Force | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $ModelRoot "embeddings/negatives") -Force | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $ModelRoot "embeddings/lazy") -Force | Out-Null

# Process each file
foreach ($file in $files) {
    $origFullPath = $file.FullName
    $relPath = $file.RelativePath
    $origDir = $file.Directory.Name
    $origFileName = $file.Name -replace '\.safetensors$', ''
    
    # Determine category based on parent directory
    $categoryKey = $origDir
    $catInfo = $CategoryMap[$origDir]
    
    if (-not $catInfo) {
        # Try partial match
        foreach ($key in $CategoryMap.Keys) {
            if ($origDir -match [regex]::Escape($key)) {
                $categoryKey = $key
                $catInfo = $CategoryMap[$key]
                break
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (-not $catInfo) {
        Write-Host "WARNING: No category mapping for directory: $origDir - file: $($file.Name)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        continue
    }
    
    $modelType = $catInfo.type
    $renameFunc = $catInfo.rename
    $newFileName = & $renameFunc $origFileName
    $newFileNameFull = "$newFileName.safetensors"
    
    # Determine target subdirectory
    $targetSubDir = $origDir
    if ($catInfo.subdir) {
        foreach ($k in $catInfo.subdir.Keys) {
            if ($origFileName -match [regex]::Escape($k)) {
                $targetSubDir = $catInfo.subdir[$k]
                break
            }
        }
    }
    
    $targetDir = Join-Path $ModelRoot $targetSubDir
    $targetPath = Join-Path $targetDir $newFileNameFull
    
    # Skip if already at target location with same name
    if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
        Write-Host "SKIP (already exists): $($file.Name) -> $newFileNameFull" -ForegroundColor Gray
        # Still create metadata if missing
        $mdPath = $targetPath + $MetadataExt
        if -not (Test-Path $mdPath) {
            $md = @{
                original_filename = $file.Name
                original_full_path = $origFullPath
                original_directory = $origDir
                new_filename = $newFileNameFull
                new_full_path = $targetPath
                model_type = $modelType
                rename_date = (Get-Date).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")
                notes = "Original filename preserved for Civitai metadata compatibility"
            }
            $md | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 | Out-File -FilePath $mdPath -Encoding UTF8 -Force
        }
        continue
    }
    
    # Move file to new location
    try {
        Move-Item -Path $origFullPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Moved: $($file.Name) -> $targetSubDir/$newFileNameFull" -ForegroundColor Green
    } catch {
        Write-Host "ERROR moving $($file.Name): $_" -ForegroundColor Red
        continue
    }
    
    # Create metadata.json companion
    $md = @{
        original_filename = $file.Name
        original_full_path = $origFullPath
        original_directory = $origDir
        new_filename = $newFileNameFull
        new_full_path = $targetPath
        model_type = $modelType
        rename_date = (Get-Date).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")
        notes = "Original filename preserved for Civitai metadata compatibility"
    }
    
    $mdPath = $targetPath + $MetadataExt
    $md | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 | Out-File -FilePath $mdPath -Encoding UTF8 -Force
    
    Write-Host "Created metadata: $($mdPath.Substring($ModelRoot.Length))" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
}

Write-Host "`nOrganization complete!" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "Review the mapping and metadata files above." -ForegroundColor Yellow

End of organization script

        # bytes 2-7 should be 0x01 0x00 0x00 0x00 0x00 0x00 or 0x02 0x00 0x00 0x00 0x00 0x00
